slots.hair: down out of its ponytail, the gold face-framing pieces loose
slots.outfit: a white fitted tank and beige over-the-knee socks
slots.place: on the floor of her Seoul apartment living room with her golf bag propped against the wall, one floor lamp on
slots.action: She is sitting on the floor with her back against the sofa and one hand resting on her knee, the ponytail already out.
slots.face: Quiet — the version of her whose sentences do not rise at the end — looking at the lens.
slots.light: The floor lamp is to one side in front of her and the depth of the room and the golf bag fall into shadow.

slots.hair: long and loose, pushed over one shoulder
slots.place: sitting on the edge of the bed in her apartment, three bottles of sunscreen lined up on the nightstand
slots.action: She is sitting on the bed edge working sunscreen into one arm with the other hand still on the bottle.
slots.face: Her attention is on her arm rather than the lens, the expression very level.
slots.light: The bedside lamp is in front of her and the rest of the room is dark.

slots.hair: being tied into a ponytail, a hair tie held in her lips
slots.outfit: a white cotton robe with the neckline open
slots.place: in her bathroom in the morning, sunscreen still sitting on the counter in front of the mirror
slots.action: Her free hand is pulling her long hair up into a ponytail with the hair tie held in her lips.
slots.face: No expression with the tie in her lips, her eyes on herself in the glass.
slots.light: The light above the mirror is directly in front of her and the depth of the bathroom is dark.

slots.hair: in a low ponytail pulled through the back of a cap she is holding rather than wearing
slots.outfit: a white fitted short-sleeved polo and a grass-green high-waisted skirt
slots.place: at her own regular bay in the indoor driving range after hours, the cool white lights above that bay still on and every other bay dark
slots.action: She is leaning against the divider of the bay with a club tucked between her arm and her body and the cap in her hand.
slots.face: The bright open laugh, the version whose sentences rise at the end.
slots.light: The cool white light over her own bay is in front of her and the rest of the range is completely dark.

slots.outfit: a sky-blue fitted short-sleeved top and white high-waisted shorts
slots.place: outside a sports shop in central Seoul that is still open late, having just come out
slots.action: She has stopped at the shop door pulling on a new glove and is looking down to see whether it fits.
slots.face: Looking down, concentrating, with a small smile at the corner of her mouth.
slots.light: The shop doorway light is in front of her and the pavement beyond it goes dark.
